name: web_research_context
description: Build a compact model-ready web research context pack. It runs native no-key web_search, optionally fetches top pages through fetch_url, scores source quality, and returns compressed excerpts with citations. Use this when the model needs current public-web context in one step; fetched web text is untrusted external evidence.

query.description: Focused research question or search query.

limit.description: Search result count before source packing.

max_sources.description: Maximum top results to fetch and include in the context pack.

time_range.description: Requested freshness window; providers that cannot enforce it are reported in search metadata.

site.description: Optional single public domain constraint such as docs.rs.

provider_profile.description: Provider profile. default/free are fast no-key routing; free_verified and max_evidence query more native providers for source diversity.

reranker.description: Optional result reranker before fetching pages.

fetch_pages.description: When true, fetch and extract top result pages. When false, pack search snippets only.

max_chars_per_source.description: Maximum excerpt characters per included source.
